reason: The tray provides a place to test and balance the load on the tethered tile.
expectation: I expect the tray to attach to the lift test so the block and counterweight can be positioned on it.

alternatives.reason: Preparing the crane sling also seems useful, but I want to set up the load first.

effect: The load tray is attached, so I can test how an uneven load affects the tile.
reaction: A straightforward setup step; nothing surprising yet.
reason: The off-centre block should reveal whether the loaded tray tilts and needs balancing.
expectation: I expect the block to be placed off centre and the lift test to show an imbalance, though the result may require another test.

alternatives.reason: The crane sling may be useful later, but testing the load first seems more direct.

effect: The off-centre load makes the tray tilt, so it needs balancing as well as lift.
reaction: The visible tilt makes the balance problem clear.
reason: The sliding counterweight should balance the off-centre block.
expectation: I expect to position the counterweight until the tray sits more level.

alternatives.reason: The crane sling may be useful later, but it does not seem to address the tilt.

effect: The counterweight levels the tray but adds load, so the lift needs adjustment.
reaction: The trade-off between balance and extra weight is clear and useful.
reason: The current controller seems suited to adjusting the lift for the heavier tray.
expectation: I expect the controller and harness to allow enough additional lift to raise the balanced load, though it may need further testing.

alternatives.reason: The crane sling may be needed later, but it won't adjust the tile's lift.

effect: The lift module is now adjustable; it still needs a reliable stop.
reaction: A straightforward fitting, with no further test shown yet.
reason: The power-cut switch directly addresses the reliable-stop goal.
expectation: I expect the switch to cut power and stop the tile lifting, though it may still need testing.

alternatives.reason: The crane sling may be useful later, but the switch addresses the current goal.

effect: The power-cut switch overrides the controller, providing the reliable stop needed for the module.
reaction: The override makes the stop's purpose clear.
reason: Preparing the crane sling is the only available combination and may help move the module.
expectation: I expect the sling to attach to the crane so it can lift something, though its immediate use is unclear.

effect: The crane now has a sling in place of its basket, ready to handle the stopped module.
reaction: Reusing the crane makes the preparation feel purposeful.
reason: This is the only offered combination and should let the crane move the lift module.
expectation: I expect the crane to lift or transfer the stopped module with the sling, though I don't yet know where it will go.

effect: The crane safely transferred the complete module, with the test blocks removed and the counterweight reset for an empty tray. The chapter goal is complete.
reaction: Reusing the crane for the transfer was a satisfying connection to the earlier construction.

mostWorthwhile.text: Balancing the tilted tray was most worthwhile: it showed both how a counterweight corrects a lopsided load and why the added weight requires more lift.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the controller was relatively uneventful because its result showed no further test.

surprise.text: The counterweight levelled the tray but also increased the load, creating a need for more lift.

arbitrary.text: The crane sling's immediate purpose was initially unclear, though its use in removing the module made sense afterward.

continue.text: Yes. The balance and safety tests made me curious how the completed module will be used for the fair, though several fittings were routine.
